newsitem.title: UK: BT /Reuter in BrightStar satellite pact.
newsitem.headline: BT /Reuter in BrightStar satellite pact.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc said on Tuesday it agreed with Reuters Holdings Plc to take over the international satellite transmission services of Reuters' BrightStar commercial satellite branch.
The deal will allow BT Broadcast Services to operate services using capacity on the Intelsat K satellite, which links Europe with the Americas, BT said.
Reuters will place its permanent and occasional television distribution business with BT, the telecoms giant said.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
"The BrightStar deal provides us with a dynamic market development opportunity in the digital satellite transmission business -- where we predict strong growth," BT said in a statement.

BT, set to merge with MCI Communications Corp, also said it planned to market capacity leased by MCI on certain U.S. domestic satellites, providing connectivity between Europe and the entire U.S. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
